whatever you want to call these noodles udon or champon these hand pulled noodles are worthy of the name nestled inside the takashimaya food court is a little bit of korean flavor in a japanese setting with at least a half dozen shops at saigon centre specializing in ramen egg noodles it is great to know suizan dishes up bowls of thick chewy hand pulled rice noodles the japanese call it udon koreans call it champon i call it slurping spicy goodness i chose the spicy champon already loaded with kimchi carrots roast pork squid fish cake i added a soft boiled egg and crunchy tempura bits the broth was nice and spicy i did add a few dashes of hot chili oil though not over bearing allowing you to savor every bite often chasing your bite of noodles with a good slurp it was steaming hot and clear becoming cloudy with bits of eggs and runny yolk swirling throughout as i mixed it up the tempura bits soak up the broth adding a great richness to the dish i would even sprinkle some onto my noodles just to get a crunchy bite in every now and then if you follow me you know it is all about texture right succulent roast pork tender squid cabbage and carrots i guarantee you that every bite will have a different flavor and feel the noodles are not too thick they are not too thin not every noodle is the same and in a shopping center with over a dozen places serving noodles being different with hand pulled udon definitely puts suizan on my list of must try followed by must return another sure fire winner in my book

singapore island city state is well known around the world for her variety of food and culture and if one wishes to have a taste of singapore look no further than to lion city this restuarant has established itself as a reputable franchise offering quality and authentic singaporean food it now has a couple of franchise outlets scattered in vietnam this restaurant which we visited was the main outlet that was started by its founder harry ang upon walking into the restaurant you will be greeted by displays of live giant mud crabs these species are not local crabs which are small and thin with almost no meat these crabs are fleshy and sweet and the stars for lion city s signature dish chilli crabs we must first warn you that a crab will easily cost but they are worth every bite if you are a crab lover the chilli crab served here is pretty close to what is served in singapore so there is not much to complain except the sauce could be more spicer for more menace one dish we truly loved was the lady s finger with sambal the sambal was exceptionally fantastic till now the taste of the shrimp paste in the sambal lingers in our palates overall the food was truly tasty and better than what we had expected the next time we would be trying their other signature dish the frog porridge food type and taste singaporean cuisine stars price mid to high range ambience great place for any ocassion ample of dining space
